Subject: Discrepancy on Sept invoice / VAT documentation request

Hi Markus,

Hope you’re well. Our finance team picked up an unexpected uplift on invoice INV-11234 for September — usage appears ~18% higher than our dashboard and our internal metering. Could you help us with: 1) a short explanation of the variance, and 2) an adjustment or goodwill credit while we reconcile?

We’re EU-registered and can provide our VAT registration certificate and the PO number if that helps processing a credit or reissued invoice with reverse-charge treatment.

For timing: our month-end is Nov 10; if we can get confirmation and a corrected invoice/credit note before then, it would avoid a manual withholding on our side.

Attaching the PO for reference.

Thanks —
Sophia
Sophia Marshall
Head of Finance, BrightLeaf AI

Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Sept invoice / VAT documentation request

Hi Sophia — thanks for flagging and for attaching the PO.

Short answer: we’ll provisionally apply a goodwill credit for the overbilled usage while our billing team runs a meter reconciliation. To move quickly we need your VAT certificate (so we can decide whether to reissue an invoice with reverse charge) and confirmation you want the credit applied as a credit note on the next invoice vs. an immediate refund.

Proposed next steps:
- You send VAT certificate (or VAT reg. number) + confirm credit preference (credit note vs refund) — by EOD Mon (Nov 2) if possible.
- My team will reserve the credit and run a meter diff; if reconciliation shows a lower variance we’ll adjust the credit accordingly.
- We’ll reissue the corrected invoice / credit note and share a DocuSign-ready credit note for your records.

I’ve looped in Priyom (billing) and Olga (collections) to lock the accounting flow.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding Sophia’s note. Quick checklist for bookkeeping:

- Reserve provisional credit of EUR 6,200 on customer account BL-2026-7893 (this is ~18% of invoice total). Mark as provisional pending meter reconciliation.
- If customer provides EU VAT certificate and requests reverse charge, we need to reissue with zero VAT and a credit note for the overcharge.
- Capture PO number 7893 on the credit note to make reconciliation on their side easier.

Olga, can you confirm we have the ledger space to hold the provisional credit and whether we should treat this as a goodwill credit (expense) vs. contra-revenue posting?

Thanks — Priyom

2) We reissued INV-11234 as a zero-VAT invoice under reverse-charge; the credit note CN-20261101-045 has been generated and will be applied to your next invoice.
3) Reissued invoice & credit note (PDFs) are available here: https://invoices.redwood.ai/issued/INV-11234 (Doc IDs attached). DocuSign routing is enabled if you need a signed copy: https://app.docusign.com/documents/DS-99876.

Sophia — let me know if you need the credit paid as a refund instead; otherwise we’ll count this resolved for your Nov close. Thanks for the quick turnaround on the VAT docs.
